data.one_liner: Free icon library for Flutter featuring over 4,600 icons in solid and stroke styles.
data.what_it_does: Provides a large collection of over 4,600 icons available in solid and stroke styles for Flutter applications. Icons can be easily customized in size and color, and integrated directly into standard Flutter widgets like Icon and IconButton.
use_when: You need a large variety of modern icons in both solid and stroke styles.
You want easy icon integration using standard Flutter Icon widgets.
avoid_when: You only require a standard Material Design icon set already provided by Flutter.
You need custom SVG parsing at runtime instead of packaged font or asset icons.
strengths: Features 4,687 icons for both solid and stroke styles.
Simple usage with familiar Flutter Icon and IconButton widgets.
Handles Dart naming rules for icons starting with numbers or duplicates.
weaknesses: Limited documentation beyond basic README instructions.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import 'package:hugeicons_pro/hugeicons.dart'.

alternatives.name: font_awesome_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer the widely used Font Awesome icon set instead of Hugeicons.

alternatives.name: lucide_icons_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer the Lucide icon set style.

alternatives.name: material_symbols_icons
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want Google's Material Symbols icon set.
